name: Exp_GStopLoss_Tm
summary: This EA is a virtual trailing stop utility that moves Stop Loss levels based on Parabolic SAR indicator values. It operates on a timer-based schedule, allowing traders to restrict the trailing stop function to specific trading sessions or time windows.
summary_zh: 这是一个基于抛物线SAR指标移动止损位的虚拟追踪止损工具EA。它支持定时器调度功能，允许交易者将追踪止损操作限制在特定的交易时段或时间窗口内。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非自主开仓的交易策略，而是一个止损管理工具。其核心机制是读取Parabolic SAR指标的数值，当SAR值朝有利方向移动时，自动更新持仓的止损位以锁定浮动利润。入场条件不适用，因为EA不自行开仓；出场条件体现为止损位的逐步追踪上移（或多头下移），最终在价格回撤时触发追踪止损平仓。仓位管理不涉及，EA仅管理已有持仓的止损。资金管理方面，EA通过追踪止损机制间接保护账户资金，防止盈利单回撤为亏损。定时器功能允许用户设定激活和停用时间，使追踪止损仅在特定时段生效，避免在流动性差或波动剧烈的时段产生不必要止损调整。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a self-trading strategy but a stop-loss management utility. Its core mechanism reads the Parabolic SAR indicator values and automatically updates the stop-loss level of existing positions as the SAR moves favorably, thereby locking in floating profit. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open its own trades. Exit conditions manifest as the trailing stop level being progressively moved upward for longs or downward for shorts, eventually triggering a close when price retraces to the trailed stop. Position sizing is not involved as the EA only manages stop-losses of existing positions. Money management is indirectly supported through the trailing stop mechanism which protects account equity by preventing winning trades from turning into losers. The timer feature allows users to set activation and deactivation times, enabling the trailing stop to function only during specified trading sessions and avoiding unnecessary stop adjustments during low-liquidity or highly volatile periods.

parameters.name: TimeFrame
parameters.description: 抛物线SAR指标的时间周期

parameters.name: SAR_Maximum
parameters.description: Parabolic SAR的加速因子最大值

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 初始止损点数，0表示不设初始止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Group take profit target amount (in currency)

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 固定点数追踪止损，0表示使用SAR追踪
parameters.description_en: Fixed-point trailing stop, 0 means use SAR trailing

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 追踪止损最小移动步幅点数
parameters.description_en: Minimum step for stop loss movement (points)

parameters.name: Number
parameters.description: 要管理的持仓编号，0表示管理所有持仓
parameters.description_en: Position number to manage, 0 means manage all

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 持仓的魔术编号筛选，-1表示所有

parameters.name: TimeStart
parameters.description: 追踪止损激活时间（小时）

parameters.name: TimeEnd
parameters.description: 追踪止损停用时间（小时）

parameters.name: CloseTime
parameters.description: 到达停用时间时是否强制平仓
parameters.description_en: Whether to force close positions at deactivation time

pros: 基于Parabolic SAR的动态追踪止损比固定点数追踪更灵活，能适应市场波动节奏
定时器功能允许在特定时段启用/禁用追踪止损，适应不同市场阶段的需求
支持按魔术编号和持仓编号筛选，可精确控制需要管理的持仓范围
同时支持SAR追踪和固定点数追踪两种模式，灵活度高
pros_en: Parabolic SAR-based dynamic trailing stop is more adaptive than fixed-pip trailing, adjusting to market volatility rhythm
Timer functionality allows enabling/disabling trailing stop during specific sessions, adapting to different market phases
Supports filtering by magic number and position number, enabling precise control over which positions to manage
Supports both SAR-based and fixed-pip trailing modes, providing high flexibility
cons: 作为工具型EA，不提供自主交易信号，完全依赖交易者手动开仓或其他EA提供信号
Parabolic SAR在震荡行情中频繁反转，可能导致止损被过早触发造成频繁小亏损
没有考虑点差和滑点对追踪止损实际执行价格的影响
定时器仅支持按小时设定，缺乏更精细的分钟级时间控制
cons_en: As a utility EA, it provides no autonomous trading signals, relying entirely on manual trade entry or other EAs for signals
Parabolic SAR frequently reverses in ranging markets, potentially triggering stops prematurely and causing frequent small losses
Does not account for spread and slippage impact on the actual execution price of the trailing stop
Timer only supports hour-level settings, lacking finer minute-level time control
improvements: 增加SAR信号确认过滤机制，例如结合ADX趋势强度指标避免在震荡行情中频繁调整止损
支持分钟级定时器精度，并允许设定多个不连续的活跃时段
improvements_en: Add SAR signal confirmation filtering, such as combining ADX trend strength indicator to avoid frequent stop adjustments in ranging markets
Support minute-level timer precision and allow setting multiple non-contiguous active time windows

risk_points: SAR在震荡市中频繁反转可能使止损过近，增加被扫损的概率
定时器关闭时段若市场大幅波动，止损将不会被调整，存在保护缺失窗口
risk_points_en: SAR frequent reversals in ranging markets may bring stops too close, increasing probability of being stopped out
During timer-inactive periods, stops will not be adjusted, creating a protection gap if market moves sharply
